title: ENOENT from INIT not promoted to CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE
description: Trigger: INIT ioctl returns ENOENT when no provider is registered for the requested algo (confirmed in crypto2dev_fd.c:767 and 781 — also returned when FIPS mode is active and the algo has no FIPS-validated provider). crypto2dev_to_wc_err(ENOENT) = BAD_FUNC_ARG. Neither crypto2dev_cipher() nor crypto2dev_hash() promotes BAD_FUNC_ARG to CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE — only NOT_COMPILED_IN (from EOPNOTSUPP/ENOSYS) is promoted. Bad behavior: wc_AesGcmEncrypt / wc_Sha256Update returns BAD_FUNC_ARG (hard error) instead of CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE (software fallback). Real trigger: any deployment where not all algorithms have providers loaded — e.g., FIPS mode with a provider that registers AES but not SHA. The SHA INIT gets ENOENT; the port returns BAD_FUNC_ARG; wolfSSL aborts instead of using software SHA.
